estimator: Logistic L2=10; six price features, or same price plus three amount and three style features
training: quarterly expanding fit; labels confirmed by previous close; >=10 independent positive events; full 7-decision positive windows, overlapping weights accumulated
notification: one initial upward crossing; lock through D+6; rearm only on a subsequent below-threshold observation after lock
initial_target_boundary: start+7, retained for exact historical cohort comparison
evaluation_maturity: confirmation+140 common frontier across both labels; retained only as historical evaluation buffer, not training wait
baseline: unchanged historical original price rule, rescored on same cohort
